    # Remove leading line number pattern like "  42\t"
    import re
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^\s*\d+\t', '', line)
    lines.append(cleaned)

# Now search for function definitions

    stripped = line.strip()
    if stripped.startswith('def '):
        print(f"Line {i+1}: {stripped}")
